product_family: VistaCreate (formerly Crello) is an online graphic design tool offering drag-and-drop design templates, AI-powered editing features (image generation, background removal, object removal), stock media library (1M+ free, 70M+ paid), and team collaboration tools. Available as free Starter tier and Pro subscription ($10-13/month).

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: A 2019 announcement, 'Vista achieves ISO 27001 in June 2019,' refers to Vista Technology Support, a UK-based managed service provider for retail and hospitality, not the parent company Cimpress/VistaCreate. No ISO 27001 certification was found for VistaCreate's actual parent entity.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type I
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found. Cimpress/Vista does not disclose SOC 2 attestation in their privacy or security pages.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found. Cimpress/Vista does not disclose SOC 2 attestation in their privacy or security pages.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: Vendor privacy policy states: 'Vista serves and shall be considered as a "Processor" and not as the "Controller"' for End Users Information, and that transfers outside the EEA/UK/Switzerland 'will only take place under an approved transfer mechanism, such as through the use of standard contractual clauses approved by the European Commission.'

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of HIPAA compliance or Business Associate Agreement offerings. Product is positioned as consumer/SMB design tool, not healthcare-focused.

privacy.ai_training_note: VistaCreate offers AI-powered features (AI Image Generator, AI Writer, AI Object Remover) with 100 monthly credits for Pro users. However, no public disclosure found regarding whether customer designs or inputs are used to train these AI models. No opt-out mechanism documented. This represents an ambiguity in an AI-native product with real-time generative capabilities.
privacy.data_region: Unknown. Privacy policy references Standard Contractual Clauses for EU data transfers but does not specify data center locations or regional data residency commitments.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: Stated. Privacy policy confirms 'encryption methods' implemented as part of 'technical and organisational security measures.'

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: Not explicitly specified in public documents.

security.name: Access controls
security.value: Stated. Privacy policy mentions 'access controls, controlled administration of user rights, and limiting access to personal information on a need-to-know basis.'

security.name: Data retention policy
security.value: General statement: data retained as long as necessary for purpose. Specific retention windows not disclosed.

security.name: Vulnerability disclosure / bug bounty
security.value: Email provided: bugbounty@cimpress.com. No formal public bug bounty program details disclosed.

security.name: Third-party security assessments
security.value: Parent company (Vista Technology Support, different entity) engaged LRQA for ISO 27001 validation in 2019. No recent independent audits published for Cimpress/VistaCreate.

products.name: VistaCreate Free (Starter tier)
products.data_scope: User designs, account info, minimal usage telemetry
products.notes: 50K+ static and animated templates, 1M+ royalty-free assets with unlimited downloads, background remover, basic brand kit. AI generation credits (100 monthly) are confirmed for the Pro tier; availability on the Free tier is unconfirmed.

products.name: VistaCreate Pro ($10-13/month)
products.data_scope: User designs, account info, usage analytics, collaboration data for up to 10 team members
products.notes: 150K+ templates, 70M+ premium assets, unlimited brand kits, unlimited storage, resize tool, sticker maker, team collaboration, version history, 100 AI credits monthly, social media scheduling

compare.pricing_model: Freemium: Free Starter tier + Pro subscription ($10/month annual, $13/month monthly). No enterprise tier disclosed.
compare.data_residency: Unspecified. Cimpress mentions Standard Contractual Clauses for EU transfers but no commitment to data location.

flags: Several unrelated companies share the 'Vista' name. 'Vista achieves ISO 27001' refers to Vista Technology Support, a UK-based managed IT services provider, not Cimpress/VistaCreate.
No public trust center. Security/compliance info is embedded in privacy policy only, no dedicated transparency portal.
No SOC 2 attestation found. Enterprise buyers may require this; not disclosed.

The product has real-time generative AI features (AI Image Generator, AI Writer, AI Object Remover), but there is no public disclosure of whether customer inputs or designs are used for model training. The Terms & Conditions do not address AI-specific data usage.

Parent company VistaPrint exposed 51,000+ customer service records (chats, emails, and phone transcripts containing PII) in November 2019, due to an unencrypted database left accessible online. The incident was disclosed following a TechCrunch report.
No HIPAA offerings or BAA documentation found. Not positioned as healthcare-compliant.
No mention of ISO 27001, ISO 27701, CSA STAR AI, or other modern data governance certs for actual product entity (Cimpress/VistaCreate).
Data residency: No regional data center commitments published. EU transfers use SCCs (GDPR-compliant) but location unspecified.
